title: [EVPN]Orchagent crashes when there are multiple routes to a nexthop group and they withdraw
author: dgsudharsan
body:
<!--

     to the existing issue instead.

     If you suspect your issue is a bug, please edit your issue description to

     BUG REPORT INFORMATION
     ---------------------------------------------------
     Use the commands below to provide key information from your environment:
     You do NOT have to include this information if this is a FEATURE REQUEST
-->

#### Description
When multiple routes point to a nexthop group which means the ref count of ngh is more than one, there is an error condition in the removal flow. The original logic is to remove nhg only when ref count becomes zero. However due to the structuring of if else statements, if the nhg count is not zero, the logic fallbacks to removeOverlayNextHops which will also get added to the list of tasks.
Later when bulker logic kicks in, the nexthop group removal will remove the nexthops associated. However the removeOverlayNextHops  will also subsequently try to remove the same nexthops resulting in errors below.


```
Apr 19 11:51:05.323909 anc-ali-t9 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeRoutePost: Remove overlay Nexthop 173.106.106.2@vniVlan30@30@b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc,173.108.108.2@vniVlan30@30@c2:72:8d:aa:61:d2
Apr 19 11:51:05.323976 anc-ali-t9 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeRoutePost: Remove overlay Nexthop 173.106.106.2@vniVlan30@30@b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc

Apr 19 11:51:05.330400 anc-ali-t9 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeNextHopTunnel: NH tunnel remove for vtep1, ip 173.106.106.2, mac b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc, vni 30
Apr 19 11:51:05.330658 anc-ali-t9 NOTICE syncd#SDK: [SAI_NEXT_HOP.NOTICE] mlnx_sai_nexthop.c[1431]- mlnx_remove_next_hop: Remove next hop next hop id 326, ext 1
Apr 19 11:51:05.331108 anc-ali-t9 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeTunnelNextHop: Removed Tunnel next hop vtep1, 173.106.106.2@30@b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc
Apr 19 11:51:05.331877 anc-ali-t9 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeOverlayNextHops: Remove overlay Nexthop 173.106.106.2@vniVlan30@30@b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc,173.108.108.2@vniVlan30@30@c2:72:8d:aa:61:d2
Apr 19 11:51:05.331877 anc-ali-t9 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeOverlayNextHops: Remove overlay Nexthop 173.106.106.2@vniVlan30@30@b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc,173.108.108.2@vniVlan30@30@c2:72:8d:aa:61:d2
Apr 19 11:51:05.331877 anc-ali-t9 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeNextHopTunnel: NH tunnel remove for vtep1, ip 173.106.106.2, mac b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc, vni 30
Apr 19 11:51:05.331877 anc-ali-t9 ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeTunnelNextHop: Failed to remove Tunnel next hop vtep1, 173.106.106.2@30@b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc
Apr 19 11:51:05.331877 anc-ali-t9 ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeOverlayNextHops: Tunnel Nexthop 173.106.106.2@vniVlan30@30@b6:a1:0b:0b:d3:cc,173.108.108.2@vniVlan30@30@c2:72:8d:aa:61:d2 delete failed
```

ets assume NH1 is part of NHG and R1 is pointing to NH1 and R2 is pointing to NH2. 
When both R1 and R2 are deleted,  NH1 delete comes first which reduces ref count of NH1 and adds it to m_bulkNhgReducedRefCnt. Later NHG comes and its added to m_bulkNhgReducedRefCnt.

However when m_bulkNhgReducedRefCnt is later processed, NHG delete is processed first which checks for NH1 ref count after removing NHG and finds it zero (since it was removed even before adding to m_bulkNhgReducedRefCnt). This removes the NH1 as part of NHG removal. Later when NH1 removal is processed while iterating through  m_bulkNhgReducedRefCnt  it leads to error.
```
Apr 24 15:33:35.313676 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeRoutePost: Remove overlay Nexthop 173.116.116.2@vniVlan27@27@da:d0:2e:40:6d:ba
Apr 24 15:33:35.315774 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeNextHopGroup: Delete next hop group 173.108.108.2@vniVlan27@27@7a:1e:b3:02:cd:55,173.116.116.2@vniVlan27@27@da:d0:2e:40:6d:ba

Apr 24 15:33:35.318345 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeNextHopTunnel: NH tunnel remove for vtep1, ip 173.108.108.2, mac 7a:1e:b3:02:cd:55, vni 27
Apr 24 15:33:35.318646 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE syncd#SDK: [SAI_NEXT_HOP.NOTICE] mlnx_sai_nexthop.c[1431]- mlnx_remove_next_hop: Remove next hop next hop id 3782, ext 1
Apr 24 15:33:35.319188 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeTunnelNextHop: Removed Tunnel next hop vtep1, 173.108.108.2@27@7a:1e:b3:02:cd:55
Apr 24 15:33:35.319188 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeNextHopTunnel: NH tunnel remove for vtep1, ip 173.116.116.2, mac da:d0:2e:40:6d:ba, vni 27
Apr 24 15:33:35.319491 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE syncd#SDK: [SAI_NEXT_HOP.NOTICE] mlnx_sai_nexthop.c[1431]- mlnx_remove_next_hop: Remove next hop next hop id 6918, ext 1
Apr 24 15:33:35.320017 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeTunnelNextHop: Removed Tunnel next hop vtep1, 173.116.116.2@27@da:d0:2e:40:6d:ba
Apr 24 15:33:35.320847 anc-ali-t11 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeNextHopTunnel: NH tunnel remove for vtep1, ip 173.116.116.2, mac da:d0:2e:40:6d:ba, vni 27
Apr 24 15:33:35.320847 anc-ali-t11 ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeTunnelNextHop: Failed to remove Tunnel next hop vtep1, 173.116.116.2@27@da:d0:2e:40:6d:ba
Apr 24 15:33:35.320847 anc-ali-t11 ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeOverlayNextHops: Tunnel Nexthop 173.116.116.2@vniVlan27@27@da:d0:2e:40:6d:ba delete failed

```
<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Create ECMP and have multiple routes point. Make few routes point to individual nexthops in ECMP
2. Withdraw the routes
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
Orchagent throws errors and crashes

#### Describe the results you expected:
No issues
